issues.description: In the solution code several comments incorrectly state that MRX measurements are performed in the Z basis, while the actual instructions used are MRX (measure X). This is an inner-artifact contradiction between the comment and the code and could confuse students about which basis is being measured (the protocol and problem text refer to X-basis logical measurements).
issues.suggested_fix: Update the misleading comments to match the code and the protocol description. For example, replace comments that say 'Measure all qubits in the Z basis' or 'Measure the ancilla in the Z basis' with 'Measure all qubits in the X basis' or 'Measure the ancilla in the X basis' respectively.
